Span A > Span B.", group = "Ichimoku Long Conditions"); i_long_cond_4 = input.bool(true, "Price Above Cloud", "Price has to be above the clouds.", group = "Ichimoku Long Conditions"); i_long_cond_5 = input.bool(true, "Positive Chikou", "Lagging span has to be higher than price at displacement.", group = "Ichimoku Long Conditions"); i_long_cond_6 = input.bool(true, "Price Above Conversion", "Price has to be higher than conversion line.", group = "Ichimoku Long Conditions") | Indicator calls: ta.lowest(len); ta.highest(len)
entry_long: Source rule: (strategy.position_size  is at most  0 with all conditions true long_entry with all conditions true dateRange())
entry_short: Source rule: (strategy.position_size  is at least  0 with all conditions true short_entry with all conditions true dateRange())
exit: Source rule: (long_exit with all conditions true not i_use_SLTP); order: strategy.close("Long"); Source rule: (short_exit with all conditions true not i_use_SLTP); order: strategy.close("Short"); Source rule: (i_use_SLTP); order: strategy.exit("TP/SL", "Long", stop = strategy.position_avg_price * (1 - i_SL / 100), limit = strategy.position_avg_price * (1 + i_TP / 100)); Source rule: (i_use_SLTP); order: strategy.exit("TP/SL", "Short", stop = strategy.position_avg_price * (1 + i_SL / 100), limit = strategy.position_avg_price * (1 - i_TP / 100))

take_profit: strategy.exit("TP/SL", "Long", stop = strategy.position_avg_price * (1 - i_SL / 100), limit = strategy.position_avg_price * (1 + i_TP / 100)); strategy.exit("TP/SL", "Short", stop = strategy.position_avg_price * (1 + i_SL / 100), limit = strategy.position_avg_price * (1 - i_TP / 100))

filters: Only conditions present in the cited source are represented in entry rules; no external filters added.
